output.summary: The 30% decline is mostly a regional trend (peers -29%) plus a venue shock. The move to Brightwater cut seats 40%, with poor transit and late-concert access. Single-ticket sales fell 45% against a peer median of -9%, and the cathedral near the rail station sold far better. The music director's repertoire is not the driver: post-1945 concerts sell the same as others at Brightwater, and loyal subscribers renew at a steady 85%. Marketing impact is unestablished because no attribution exists. Do not non-renew citing revenue or cut new music. Present a segmented analysis, separate the artistic review, use the cathedral dates and a shuttle. Hold off on replacing the marketing agency.
